claim: Mahāvaṃsa chapter I narrates a first visit of the Buddha to Mahiyangana involving yakkhas and a second visit to Nāgadīpa involving the nāga rulers Cūlodara and Mahodara; these are explicit Sri Lankan chronicle traditions, not independently established episodes of the historical Buddha's itinerary.
bounded_by: Confidence A applies to what the chronicle narrates. It must never be restated as confidence A that the visits occurred.
